'''Team Rocket and Dark Charmeleon''' (Japanese: '''ロケット団とわるいリザード''' ''{{tt|Rocket Gang|Team Rocket}} and {{OBP|Dark Charmeleon|Team Rocket 32|Bad Lizardo}}'') is the second chapter of the [[How I Became a Pokémon Card]] manga.

{{Spoilers}}

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Hitoshi]] tries to do evil deeds to join [[Team Rocket]], but they keep ending up as good deeds and go to the [[Olivine City]] HQ to observe.

==Major events==
* [[Hitoshi]]'s {{p|Charmander}} evolves into {{p|Charmeleon}}.
